name: cockpit
description: A /cockpit pane for the work around the code: an inbox of the GitHub PRs people send on Slack, each with a review by Claude or by Codex one press away, and a reaction, a threaded reply or the message in Slack one press away too; every open PR you authored and the ones merged in the last day, with CI, open review threads and whether each reached production, beside your Linear tickets in progress or done in the last day; monitoring alerts that follow one of your deploys, each compared to the PR that shipped; a button for each skill you use most; a Compact button; and a line on every tab with the usage limits, the context against the auto-compact threshold and the session's cost.

slackAppToken.title: Slack app-level token
slackAppToken.description: The xapp- token of the Slack app, with the connections:write scope. It opens the Socket Mode connection

slackUserToken.title: Slack user token
slackUserToken.description: The xoxp- user token the Slack app got when you installed it. It names channels and people

alertChannels.title: Alert channels
alertChannels.description: Comma-separated Slack channels that carry monitoring alerts, by name or id, such as prod-alerts, C0123ABCDEF

alertWindowMinutes.title: Alert watch window
alertWindowMinutes.description: Minutes after a PR reaches production during which an alert is compared to it

prodEnvironment.title: Production environment
prodEnvironment.description: The GitHub deployment environment that counts as production; any environment whose name contains it matches

pinnedSkills.title: Pinned skills
pinnedSkills.description: Comma-separated prompts that lead the Skills tab, such as pr-workflows:pr-polish, simplify. The skills that load most follow them

openOnMessage.title: Open on a new PR message
openOnMessage.description: Open the pane on its Inbox tab when a Slack message with a PR arrives

nodePath.title: Node executable
nodePath.description: The node (22 or newer) that runs the Slack sidecar; a full path where the session's PATH has none
